Capture Fixture: known bounds

The button #known is positioned at CSS coords (100, 200) with size (240, 48). After pinchtab capture --with-bounds, the ref's boundingBox should report {x: 100, y: 200, w: 240, h: 48} within 1 CSS pixel.

boundingBox is the border box — the same edge /box, screenshot?annotate=true and getBoundingClientRect report. The button #bordered is the element that makes a wrong edge unmissable: it is at (100, 400) with a border-box size of (240, 48), so its boundingBox is {x: 100, y: 400, w: 240, h: 48}, while its content box is {x: 118, y: 418, w: 204, h: 12} — a different origin AND a different size, so a padding-box reading cannot pass either.
